items.title: 白海豚颱風期間執行台海交管 航港局譴責：中共假執法、真擴權
items.title_en: White Dolphin Typhoon Enforces Taiwan Strait Traffic Control; Port Authority Condemns China’s Pseudo‑Enforcement and Power Grab
paras: 白海豚颱風已逐漸遠離台灣周邊海域，對近期中國廣東海事局以颱風影響為由，宣布對航經台灣海峽南口北上船舶實施交通管制，並要求船舶聽從其海事管理機構指揮一事。交通部航港局於今 (10) 日發布譴責，強調該局除已於第一時間即透過海岸電台等發布訊文，且據聯合國海洋法公約，中共無權對台海區域行使任何形式的控制權或管轄權，請周邊海域船舶無須理會中國海上交通管制要求，應自行規劃安全水域規避風險。

航港局指出，航港局於海上颱風警報發布前夕，即已透過新聞稿、海岸電台、船舶自動識別系統 (AIS) 等多元管道廣播周邊海域船舶防災告警，8 月 6 日更提早啟動近岸 12 浬海域警戒區淨空管制措施。並籲請航經台灣北部及東部周邊海域警戒區內船舶駛離近岸 12 浬海域警戒區避風，也協調海巡署執行必要驅離作業，同時清楚告知周邊船舶倘仍於警戒區滯留，後續將依商港法禁止進入我國各商港，因此白海豚颱風行經台灣周邊海域期間無發生任何海事案件，成功守護談台灣周邊海域船舶航行安全。
航港局再強調，針對台灣周邊海域，中華民國才是聯合國海洋法公約具法定主權之「沿岸國」，始有權對周邊船舶進行海上交通管制措施，而台灣海峽為國際水域，依據《聯合國海洋法公約》等國際規範，領海範圍外均適用國際法公海航行自由原則，中國無任何權利針對該水域之外國及我國船舶實施交通管制。
航港局也嚴正譴責中國假借颱風防災之名，遂行「假執法、真擴權、真騷擾」之不當行為。
paras_en: The White Dolphin typhoon has gradually moved away from the waters surrounding Taiwan. Recently, China’s Guangdong Maritime Safety Administration, citing the typhoon’s impact, announced traffic control for vessels sailing north through the southern mouth of the Taiwan Strait and demanded that ships obey its maritime authority. The Ministry of Transportation and Communications’ Port and Harbor Administration issued a condemnation on the 10th, stressing that it had immediately broadcast notices via coastal radio stations and, under the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea, the Chinese Communist Party has no right to exercise any form of control or jurisdiction over the Taiwan Strait area. Vessels in the surrounding waters are therefore not required to heed China’s maritime traffic control requests and should plan safe routes to avoid risk.

The Port and Harbor Administration noted that, on the eve of the maritime typhoon warning, it had already disseminated disaster‑prevention alerts to ships in nearby waters through press releases, coastal radio, and the Automatic Identification System (AIS). On August 6 it pre‑emptively activated a clearance control zone covering 12 nautical miles off the coast. It urged vessels navigating the northern and eastern Taiwan offshore warning zones to steer clear of the 12‑nautical‑mile coastal zone, coordinated with the Coast Guard Administration to carry out necessary expulsion operations, and warned that any ship remaining in the warning zone would be barred from entering Taiwan’s commercial ports under the Port Law. No maritime incidents occurred while the White Dolphin typhoon passed the surrounding waters, successfully safeguarding the safety of vessels near Taiwan.

The administration further emphasized that, regarding the waters around Taiwan, the Republic of China is the legally sovereign “coastal state” under the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea and therefore alone has the authority to impose maritime traffic‑control measures on nearby vessels. The Taiwan Strait is international waters; under the UNCLOS and other international norms, the high‑seas freedom of navigation principle applies beyond territorial seas, and China has no right to impose traffic control on foreign or Taiwanese ships in those waters.

The Port and Harbor Administration also strongly condemned China for exploiting the typhoon disaster‑prevention pretext to carry out “pseudo‑enforcement, real power expansion, and genuine harassment” of improper conduct.

items.title: 〈聯強法說〉第二季獲利質變大幅成長 AI浪潮展望樂觀旺至明年
items.title_en: Uniflex Reports Significant Profit Growth in Q2, AI Demand to Drive Future Growth
paras: 聯強 (2347-TW) 今 (10) 日舉行法人說明會，公司第二季獲利結構隨著營收顯著規模化實現質變大幅成長，單季與上半年獲利指標表現優異，聯強副總裁杜書全指出，企業對人工智慧伺服器與資料中心升級的商用剛性需求極為強勁，將持續成為帶動下半年與未來長線營運成長的核心動能。
聯強 2026 年第二季合併營收首度突破 2000 億元大關，達 2010 億元，年增 115%，季增 59%，第二季營業利益達 48 億元，年增 250%，稅後淨利 39 億元，每股純益 2.34 元，年增 197%，累計上半年合併營收達 3274 億元，年增 77%，已達去年全年營收近八成，上半年稅後淨利 68.64 億元，每股純益達 4.12 元，股東權益報酬率提升至 19%。
針對財務指標與毛利率變化，第二季毛利率降至 3.4%，主因接獲金額高達幾十億元的大型專案，專案毛利率相對較低，但營業費用率大幅下滑至 1%，使得營業利益率拉升至 2.38%，上半年營業利益率更達到 2.49% 創歷年新高，營運槓桿效益顯著。
細分產品項目，商用價值業務中以伺服器表現最為強勁，第二季營收大幅成長五倍，儲存系統與網路設備亦分別成長將近 50% 與 30%，雲端業務穩健成長 9%，家用產品方面，商用筆電與桌電成長 44%，消費型筆電成長 33%，整體電腦業務成長 37%，顯示歐美等市場具備強烈剛性需求，電競產品成長 7%，穿戴式裝置等消費電子也維持雙位數成長。
杜書全分析，AI 建置已從過去的概念驗證階段，走向企業端大規模量產部署，過去集中於大型雲端服務供應商資料中心的需求，已逐漸延伸至大型企業與工業電腦廠，帶動資料中心硬體設施與具備 AI 終端設備的升級浪潮，半導體業務更因與高階半導體及記憶體供需不平衡、價格飆漲，呈現量增價增的強勁格局。
各區域市場方面，第二季中國大陸與台灣市場營收受惠商用需求與大型專案皆呈現倍增，印尼市場成長超過 20%，紐澳市場成長 10%，香港市場 7 月份也已轉為正成長，其中中國大陸積極推動政府與國企資訊科技設備國產化，聯強深化與華為、浪潮、清華同方及信創業者合作，台灣則掌握銀行與晶片設計公司大型專案，紐澳與印尼市場的手機業務更分別實現 50% 與 72% 的高成長。
展望下半年與長線趨勢，杜書全表示，低單價手機因零組件成本上升無法推出，市場轉向中高單價產品，加上價格調漲後不易回落，價格紅利將持續發酵，下半年伴隨傳統消費旺季、AI 新算力平台與蘋果新機問世，下半年與明年營運展望保持非常樂觀，並將透過智慧供應鏈平台持續優化運作效率。
paras_en: Uniflex (2347-TW) held its investor conference today, where the company reported significant growth in its second-quarter earnings, driven by substantial scale and improved profitability. According to Uniflex Vice President Du Shuquan, the demand for AI servers and data center upgrades from enterprises is extremely strong and will continue to drive growth in the second half of the year and beyond.

Uniflex's consolidated revenue for the second quarter of 2026 exceeded NT$200 billion for the first time, reaching NT$201 billion, representing a 115% year-over-year increase and a 59% quarter-over-quarter increase. The company's operating profit for the quarter was NT$4.8 billion, up 250% year-over-year, with net profit after tax of NT$3.9 billion and earnings per share of NT$2.34, representing a 197% year-over-year increase.

In terms of financial indicators and gross margin changes, the second-quarter gross margin decreased to 3.4%, mainly due to the receipt of large-scale projects with lower margins. However, the operating expense ratio decreased significantly to 1%, resulting in an increase in the operating profit margin to 2.38%, with the first-half operating profit margin reaching a record high of 2.49%, demonstrating significant operating leverage.

Breaking down product categories, commercial products, particularly servers, showed the strongest performance, with second-quarter revenue growing fivefold. Storage systems and network equipment also grew by nearly 50% and 30%, respectively, while cloud services maintained stable growth of 9%. On the consumer side, commercial laptops and desktops grew 44%, consumer laptops grew 33%, and overall computer business grew 37%, indicating strong demand in European and American markets.

Du Shuquan analyzed that AI construction has transitioned from the concept verification stage to large-scale deployment, with demand extending from major cloud service providers to large enterprises and industrial computer manufacturers, driving an upgrade wave in data center hardware and AI-enabled devices. The semiconductor business also showed strong growth due to the imbalance between supply and demand for high-end semiconductors and memory, leading to price increases.

In terms of regional markets, second-quarter revenue in mainland China and Taiwan benefited from commercial demand and large-scale projects, with growth exceeding 20% in Indonesia, 10% in Australia and New Zealand, and 7% in Hong Kong. Uniflex has deepened its cooperation with Huawei, Inspur, Tsinghua Tongfang, and other partners in mainland China, while in Taiwan, the company has secured major projects from banks and chip design companies.

Looking ahead to the second half of the year and long-term trends, Du Shuquan expressed optimism, citing the shift towards mid-to-high-end products, price increases, and the upcoming traditional consumption season, as well as the launch of new AI platforms and Apple devices. The company will continue to optimize its operational efficiency through its smart supply chain platform.

items.title: 受黑海地區供給中斷影響 小麥價格創本月新高
items.title_en: Global Food Prices Rise Amid Black Sea Disruptions
paras: 由於俄羅斯與烏克蘭在黑海地區針對彼此出口設施的攻擊力道增強，市場對全球糧食供應安全的高度擔憂推升了糧食期貨價格。芝加哥小麥期貨於周一 (10 日) 再度走高，並帶動玉米與黃豆價格同步上揚。
黑海是俄羅斯與烏克蘭這兩大農業強國的主要出口門戶。隨著雙方加強對糧食基礎設施及船隻的打擊，市場對航運可靠性的疑慮已轉化為價格動能。
芝加哥期貨交易所 (CBOT) 交易最活躍的小麥合約周一一度上漲 2.5%，創下 7 月 30 日以來新高，這已是小麥價格連續第 4 個交易日上漲，創下近兩個月來最長的連漲紀錄。
其中，硬紅冬麥 (Hard Red Winter wheat) 的漲幅尤為顯著，上漲達 2.7% 至每蒲式耳 7.5050 美元。由於此品種是黑海與歐洲高蛋白磨粉小麥的直接競爭產品，出口中斷迫使全球進口商必須尋求更多元的供應來源，進一步推升了高品質小麥的價值。
烏克蘭總統澤倫斯基 (Volodymyr Zelenskiy) 直指莫斯科打擊港口的行為是在針對全球糧食安全。烏克蘭官方警告，受持續攻擊影響，其 2026-27 年度的農產品出口量可能較先前預期減少超過一半。土耳其也因黑海航路安全風險增加，一度暫停其船隻的過境。
摩根大通指出，裝載速度放緩與保險成本上升，已實質導致了市場的「風險溢價」。此外，烏克蘭對俄羅斯燃料供應的打擊，亦可能限制農用機具所需的柴油供應，進而影響俄方的農業生產。
除了地緣政治，氣候乾旱也威脅著其他產區。法國因熱浪與旱災影響，預計今年玉米產量將較 2025 年驟減 35% 至 900 萬公噸，創下自 1980 年以來的新低。而美元匯率跌至近兩個月低點，則提升了美國農產品在國際市場上的出口競爭力。
分析師指出，由於多個主要出口國的產量低於去年，小麥價格短期內預計將維持在每蒲式耳 6 美元以上，並可能趨向 6.50 美元。
目前交易員正密切關注美國農業部 (USDA) 即將發布的月度預測報告，以獲取有關產量與種植面積的最新數據。
paras_en: The global food supply chain has been disrupted due to the escalating attacks on export facilities by Russia and Ukraine in the Black Sea region, leading to a surge in food commodity prices. The Chicago wheat futures rose again on Monday (10th), driving up corn and soybean prices in tandem.

The Black Sea is the primary export gateway for Russia and Ukraine, two major agricultural powers. As both sides intensify their attacks on grain infrastructure and ships, market concerns about shipping reliability have turned into price momentum.

The most actively traded wheat contract on the Chicago Board of Trade (CBOT) rose 2.5% on Monday, reaching a new high since July 30, marking the fourth consecutive trading day of price increases, the longest streak in nearly two months.

Among them, the price of Hard Red Winter wheat rose 2.7% to $7.5050 per bushel. As this variety is a direct competitor to Black Sea and European high-protein milling wheat, the export disruption forces global importers to seek alternative sources, further driving up the value of high-quality wheat.

Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy directly accused Moscow of targeting global food security by attacking ports. Ukraine's officials warned that the country's agricultural exports for the 2026-27 season may be reduced by more than half due to ongoing attacks. Turkey also suspended its ships' transit due to increased risks on the Black Sea route.

Morgan Stanley noted that slowed loading speeds and increased insurance costs have effectively led to a 'risk premium' in the market. Additionally, Ukraine's attacks on Russian fuel supplies may limit the availability of diesel fuel for agricultural machinery, impacting Russia's agricultural production.

Beyond geopolitics, climate droughts also threaten other production areas. France expects its corn production to drop by 35% to 9 million tons this year due to heatwaves and droughts, a new low since 1980. The decline in the US dollar has also boosted the competitiveness of US agricultural exports in the international market.

Analysts predict that global wheat prices will remain above $6 per bushel in the short term, potentially reaching $6.50 due to lower production in several major exporting countries compared to last year.
Market participants are closely watching the upcoming monthly forecast report from the US Department of Agriculture (USDA) for the latest data on production and planting areas.

items.title: 可成上半年獲利年增逾5成 EPS 5.14元 AI產品放量帶動營收逐月增
items.title_en: Chen Hsong Sees Over 5% YoY Profit Growth in H1 EPS of NT$5.14
paras: 機殼廠可成 (2474-TW) 今 (10) 日公告最新財報，累計今年上半年稅後純益 28.4 億元，年增逾 5 成，每股純益 5.14 元。可成指出，7 月起部分 AI 專案進入量產，隨著 AI 相關產品量產規模擴大，營收可望逐月成長。
可成第二季營收 26.81 億元，季減 29%，年減 47.3%；毛利率 28.9%，季增 0.1 個百分點，年減 1.6 個百分點；營益率 1.8%，季減 4.7 個百分點，年減 15.3 個百分點；稅後純益 13.55 億元，季減 8.7%，較去年同期由虧轉盈，每股純益 2.51 元。
可成指出，受到電子料件短缺，影響筆電產品出貨，拖累第二季營收表現，加上研發費用增加，進一步影響毛利率及營益率。
可成累計今年上半年營收 64.55 億元，年減 31.6%；毛利率 28.8%，年減 3.8 個百分點；營益率 4.5%，年減 13.5 個百分點；稅後純益 28.4 億元，年增 54.1%，每股純益 5.14 元。
展望下半年，筆電方面，可成表示，由於關鍵零組件短缺情況短期難以改善，市場普遍預期今年筆電出貨將衰退雙位數；AI 相關專案上，可成指出，7 月開始部分 AI 專案已陸續進入量產，可望帶動營收逐月成長，看好 AI 業務對於下半年營收貢獻更為顯著。
可成提到，除既有 AI 產品持續出貨，其他新開發專案預計自 2027 年第一起陸續量產，AI PC 相關產品也有望於明年第二季開始量產，屆時將進一步挹注營運成長動能。
paras_en: Chen Hsong (2474-TW) announced its latest financial report today, with a net profit of NT$2.84 billion for the first half of the year, a year-over-year increase of over 5%. The company stated that some AI projects entered mass production in July, and as the scale of AI-related product production expands, revenue is expected to grow month by month.

Chen Hsong's second-quarter revenue was NT$26.81 billion, down 29% from the previous quarter and 47.3% from the same period last year. Gross margin was 28.9%, up 0.1 percentage points from the previous quarter but down 1.6 percentage points from the same period last year. Operating margin was 1.8%, down 4.7 percentage points from the previous quarter and 15.3 percentage points from the same period last year. Net profit was NT$13.55 billion, down 8.7% from the previous quarter but turned from a loss to a profit compared to the same period last year, with EPS of NT$2.51.

Chen Hsong attributed the second-quarter revenue performance to the shortage of electronic components, which affected laptop shipments, and increased research and development expenses, which further impacted gross margin and operating margin.

Chen Hsong's revenue for the first half of the year was NT$64.55 billion, down 31.6% from the same period last year. Gross margin was 28.8%, down 3.8 percentage points from the same period last year. Operating margin was 4.5%, down 13.5 percentage points from the same period last year. Net profit was NT$2.84 billion, up 54.1% from the same period last year, with EPS of NT$5.14.

Looking ahead to the second half of the year, Chen Hsong stated that the shortage of key components is unlikely to be resolved in the short term, and the market expects laptop shipments to decline by double digits this year. However, the company is optimistic about the contribution of AI-related business to revenue growth in the second half of the year.

Chen Hsong mentioned that, in addition to existing AI products, new projects are expected to enter mass production starting from the first quarter of 2027, and AI PC-related products are expected to enter mass production in the second quarter of next year, which will further inject growth momentum into the business.

展望本週，市場將聚焦美國通膨、AI 財報、台股法說三大主軸，8 月 12 日公布美國 CPI，市場預估整體 CPI 年增 3.4%、核心 CPI 年增 2.5%，若通膨持續降溫，將有助於降低聯準會升息必要性，並壓低美債殖利率，對科技股估值形成支撐，企業財報方面，(2317-TW) 鴻海，法說將聚焦 AI 伺服器、GB 系列、ASIC 及雲端資本支出，(SMCI-US) 超微電腦，(LITE-US)Lumentum ，(COHR-US) Coherent 財報則可觀察 AI 伺服器與光通訊需求，8 月 13 日公布 PPI，AMAT 財報將聚焦半導體設備支出，(8299-TW) 群聯，法說則關注 NAND、SSD 及 AI 儲存需求。

權值股方面，(2330-TW) 台積電，上漲 0.42%，收在 2380 元，7 月營收再創歷史新高，達 4,675.8 億元，月增 5.6%、年增 44.7%，不僅超越 6 月 4,426.8 億元，也優於市場預期，顯示 AI、高效能運算與先進製程需求持續強勁，累計前 7 月營收 2 兆 8,720.6 億元，年增 37%，同步創歷史新高，展望第三季，台積電預估美元營收達 446 億至 458 億美元，營運動能維持高檔，AI 需求仍是推升營收與獲利成長的核心動能；

(2317-TW) 鴻海，上漲 1.73%，收在 264.5 元，7 月營收達 9,465.13 億元，月增 15.2%、年增 54.2%，創下歷史新高，主要受惠 AI 機櫃出貨強勁，帶動雲端網路業務大幅成長，同時電腦終端、元件及消費智能產品同步繳出雙位數年增表現，展望第三季，法人看好 AI 機櫃出貨續增，搭配 ICT 產品進入下半年傳統旺季，可望推升整體營運持續向上，即使消費智能產品面臨去年高基期，仍具成長動能，鴻海預計 8 月 12 日公布第二季財報，法人維持買進評等，看好 AI 伺服器需求將持續成為主要成長引擎；

(2454-TW) 聯發科，上漲 1.54%，收在 3960 元，AI ASIC 有望成為下一具成長引擎，公司積極搶進 AI 資料中心市場，並將全球 AI ASIC 市占率目標由 10% 至 15% 上修至 15% 至 20%，目前已與大型雲端服務商合作，第一代 AI Accelerator 預計今年第四季量產，AI ASIC 今年營收可望突破 20 億美元，2027 年上看 120 億至 160 億美元，法人看好 AI 業務快速放量，2026 至 2028 年 EPS 估達 66.7 元、185.3 元及 427.3 元，獲利成長曲線明顯轉陡。

items.title: 三大未來2026年上半年獲利超越去年全年  EPS達 0.63元
items.title_en: Three Major Futures Exceeds Last Year's Full-Year Profit in First Half of 2026, EPS Reaches 0.63 Yuan
paras: 三大未來 (7761-TW) 今 (10) 日公布 2026 年上半年財報。受惠二次鋰電池處理量增加、產能利用率提升及再生料銷售表現穩健，2026 年上半年營收達 1.41 億元，稅後純益 1808 萬元，年成長 63%，每股 0.63 元。受惠營運規模持續擴大及獲利能力提升，上半年稅後純益已超越 2025 年全年水準。
公司展望，預期 2026 年下半年營運及獲利表現可望優於上半年
三大未來 2026 上半年處理量能穩定提升，電動車電池處理量較去年同期成長近八倍，二次鋰電池平均稼動率也由去年同期的 41% 提升至 50%；此外，上半年倫敦金屬交易所（LME）的鈷金屬平均報價較去年同期上揚，帶動再生料銷售收入成長，推升整體營收表現。隨著營收規模穩健擴大，在營業費用維持穩定下，上半年平均毛利率、營業利益率及稅後淨利率均較去年同期明顯改善，帶動整體獲利成長。
三大未來表示，目前二次鋰電池產能利用率約 5 成，隨著回收來源持續擴大，電動車電池處理量穩定增加，上半年電動車電池相關業務獲利貢獻比重達 2.1%，隨著車廠退役電池回收處理需求持續增加，以及大型鋰電池回收案件逐步放量，預期下半年產能利用率將持續提升，並進一步發揮規模經濟效益。
展望 2026 年下半年，三大未來表示，下半年將持續聚焦於產能利用率及製程效率的提升，拓展電動車與大型鋰電池回收業務，深化與車廠、3C 業者及事業單位的合作，並進一步強化再生料銷售及成本控管，在產能利用率持續提升，穩健推動營運成長。
三大未來公司表示，電池回收處理費以及再生料銷售收入仍為下半年主要營運成長動能，且隨著廢電池回收處理量持續提升，再生料價格維持相對有利，以及屏東佳冬廠產能效益逐步發揮，預期下半年營運及獲利表現可望優於上半年，全年營運展望維持審慎樂觀。
paras_en: Three Major Futures (7761-TW) announced its 2026 first-half financial report today (10). Benefiting from the increase in secondary lithium battery processing volume, improved production capacity utilization rate, and stable performance of recycled material sales, the company's revenue reached NT$ 14.1 billion, net profit after tax NT$ 180.8 million, with a year-on-year growth of 63%, and EPS of 0.63 yuan. Benefiting from the continuous expansion of operating scale and improved profitability, the company's net profit after tax in the first half has exceeded the full-year level of 2025.
The company's outlook is that the operating and profitability performance in the second half of 2026 is expected to be better than the first half.

Three Major Futures' 2026 first-half processing volume is expected to remain stable, with electric vehicle battery processing volume growing nearly eightfold compared to the same period last year, and the average utilization rate of secondary lithium batteries also increased from 41% last year to 50%. In addition, the average price of cobalt metal on the London Metal Exchange (LME) in the first half of the year was higher than the same period last year, driving the growth of recycled material sales revenue and pushing up overall revenue performance. As the revenue scale has been steadily expanded, with operating expenses remaining stable, the company's average gross margin, operating profit margin, and net profit margin have all improved significantly compared to the same period last year, driving overall profitability growth.

Three Major Futures stated that the current utilization rate of secondary lithium battery production capacity is around 50%, and as the source of recycled materials continues to expand, the processing volume of electric vehicle batteries is expected to remain stable, with the contribution rate of electric vehicle battery-related business reaching 2.1% in the first half. As the demand for retired electric vehicle battery recycling and processing continues to increase, and large-scale lithium battery recycling projects are gradually put into production, it is expected that the utilization rate will continue to improve in the second half, and further scale economies will be realized.

Looking ahead to the second half of 2026, Three Major Futures stated that it will continue to focus on improving production capacity utilization and process efficiency, expanding electric vehicle and large-scale lithium battery recycling businesses, deepening cooperation with automakers, 3C industry players, and business units, and further strengthening recycled material sales and cost control. As production capacity utilization continues to improve, the company expects to maintain stable growth in operating performance.

Three Major Futures stated that battery recycling processing fees and recycled material sales revenue will remain the main drivers of operating growth in the second half, and as the volume of waste battery recycling continues to increase, recycled material prices remain relatively favorable, and the efficiency of the Pingtung Jiadong Plant continues to improve, the company expects the operating and profitability performance in the second half to be better than the first half, with a cautious and optimistic outlook for the full year.

paras_en: Today (8/10), the Taiwan Stock Market concentrated market was driven by electronics value stocks, memory manufacturing, and passive components, resulting in a +702.85 point (+1.59%) surge, closing at a new high of 45,219.40 points, breaking through the 45,000 point integer threshold, and achieving a historical high. The total transaction amount reached NT$ 876,239 million.
Market Analysis

The concentrated market had strong bullish momentum, with the weighted index jumping high and continuously advancing, recovering all moving averages and achieving a historical high. The concentrated market's three major institutional investors had a large net buy of NT$ 731.67 billion, with foreign investors buying NT$ 517.15 billion, investment trusts buying NT$ 29.84 billion, and self-operating investors buying NT$ 184.68 billion. The OTC market was driven by small and medium-sized communication CPO and passive components, rising +1.93% and reaching a high of 396.92 points. Investment trusts increased their buying power in the OTC market by NT$ 30.18 billion.
Strong Industries

items.title: PCB變身印「鈔」電路板！中信009828卡位龍頭商機 看好台股今年還有高點
items.title_en: CITIC Transforms into Printing "Money" Circuit Boards! CITIC 009828 Seizes Market Opportunity, Sees High Points in Taiwan Stock Market This Year
paras: 全球 AI 伺服器、高速運算 (HPC) 及資料中心建置需求爆發，市場投資焦點已從單純的晶片與伺服器組裝，延伸至最核心的關鍵基礎設施—印刷電路板 (PCB) 與上游高階材料。瞄準此波規格升級商機，中國信託投信推出國內首檔聚焦台日韓 PCB 產業龍頭的「中信台日韓 PCB ETF(009828-TW)」，指數精選 30 檔成分股，台光電、欣興為前二大持股。經理人指出，台股短期拉回正是消化壓力、蓄積能量的良機，隨著下半年 AI 新平台拉貨潮與旺季效益發酵，台股基本面利多不變，「今年絕對還有高點可期」。
台股日前遭遇血腥 7 月，崩跌逾 3000 點，009828 擬任經理人葉松炫強調，雖然台股經歷洗盤與波動，但這僅是籌碼面的短期修正，絕非基本面轉弱。他指出，在 AI 硬體強勁需求與規格升級循環的紮實支撐下，隨著融資浮碼清洗乾淨，市場評價與動能隨時會迎來強烈的「V 轉」。

PCB 素有「電子元件之母」之稱，負責承載晶片並連接電子訊號，廣泛應用於手機、車用電子、家電、AI 伺服器與高效能運算設備。葉松炫指出，PCB 過去被視為近 20 年規格未有重大變革的景氣循環產業，但在 AI 時代已躍升為影響系統效能與穩定度的關鍵零組件。在 NVIDIA 等晶片巨頭提出的技術手冊推動下，PCB 的傳輸速度要求從過去的「台鐵」一路提升至「高鐵」乃至「光鐵」(光傳輸)，層數也從傳統 13 層倍增至 26 層以上，技術規格每 1 至 1.5 年即面臨一次升級。

葉松炫以歷史聞名的「淘金熱」為例指出，淘金客不一定能賺大錢，但提供鏟子、鐵軌與設備的「賣鏟者」永遠獲利穩定，在 AI 的巨大浪潮中，高階 PCB 及其上游材料正是典型的「賣鏟者」。根據高盛預估，2025 年至 2027 年 AI PCB 市場規模年複合成長率 (CAGR) 將達 140%，AI 銅箔基板市場更上看 179%。隨產品逐步「半導體化」，PCB 供應鏈正從傳統景氣循環股，華麗轉身為高成長、高本益比評價的科技成長股。
從全球產業版圖來看，台日韓三地高階載板與 PCB 產值占全球約九成，擁有不可替代的技術門檻，其中台灣占比約 56.5%，深耕半導體封裝與高階 PCB 製造，如台光電、欣興、台燿、金像電等，在銅箔基板 (CCL) 與高層數板具備全球領先地位。
日本占比約 36.3%，掌握高階材料與設備源頭，如日東紡織 (Nittobo) 握有高階玻纖布關鍵織布機產能，揖斐電 (Ibiden) 則為高階 IC 載板龍頭。韓國占比約 7.2%，如斗山集團 (Doosan) 等企業積極投入技術研發，成功打入全球 AI 晶片龍頭的高階 PCB 獨家供應鏈。
中信台日韓 PCB ETF(009828-TW) 追蹤「NYSE TIP 台日韓 PCB 指數」，發行價 10 元，將於 8 月 17 日至 8 月 20 日展開募集。指數精選 30 檔成分股，涵蓋核心 PCB 製造、IC 載板及上游銅箔、玻纖布等關鍵材料。截至 7 月 31 日，前十大成分股包含台光電、欣興、揖斐電、日東電工、JX 金屬、三井金屬、臻鼎 - KY、台燿、金像電及斗山集團。
中國信託投信表示，短線市場雖受景氣波動或匯率影響，但中長期而言，AI 帶動的高速傳輸與高階材料需求明確。繼先前推出的算力與電力主題 ETF(009819-TW) 後，此次推出 009828，盼協助投資人以低門檻輕鬆擁有一手掌握台日韓關鍵零組件龍頭的投資利器，完整打包 AI 升級紅利。
paras_en: The global demand for AI servers, high-performance computing (HPC), and data center construction has exploded, shifting market investment focus from simple chip and server assembly to the most critical infrastructure - printed circuit boards (PCB) and upstream high-end materials. CITIC Securities Investment Trust has launched the first domestic Taiwan-Japan-Korea PCB industry-focused ETF (009828-TW), which selects 30 constituent stocks, with Taiwan's TSMC and Unitech as the top two major shareholders. The fund manager pointed out that the recent short-term pullback in the Taiwan stock market is a good opportunity to digest pressure and accumulate energy, and with the AI new platform shipment wave and peak season effect kicking in, the Taiwan stock market's fundamental advantages remain unchanged, "This year, there will definitely be a high point to look forward to."

The Taiwan stock market recently experienced a bloody July, plummeting over 3,000 points, but CITIC Securities Investment Trust's fund manager, Ye Songxuan, emphasized that this is only a short-term correction on the capital account, not a weakening of the fundamental situation. He pointed out that under the solid support of AI hardware demand and specification upgrade cycles, with the clearing of financing floating stocks, the market's valuation and momentum will soon experience a strong "V-turn".

PCB is known as the "mother of electronic components," responsible for carrying chips and connecting electronic signals, widely used in smartphones, automotive electronics, home appliances, AI servers, and high-performance computing equipment. Ye Songxuan pointed out that PCB was previously considered a 20-year industry with no major specification changes, but in the AI era, it has become a critical component that affects system performance and stability. Under the driving of NVIDIA and other chip giants' technical manuals, PCB's transmission speed requirements have been upgraded from "bullet train" to "high-speed rail" and even "light rail" (optical transmission), and the number of layers has increased from the traditional 13 layers to 26 layers or more, with technical specifications facing upgrades every 1-1.5 years.

Ye Songxuan used the historical example of the "gold rush" to point out that gold prospectors may not necessarily make a fortune, but the "seller of shovels" who provides pickaxes, rail tracks, and equipment will always reap stable profits. In the massive AI wave, high-end PCBs and their upstream materials are typical "sellers of shovels." According to Goldman Sachs' estimates, the AI PCB market will grow at a compound annual growth rate (CAGR) of 140% from 2025 to 2027, while the AI copper foil substrate market will grow even faster at 179%. As products gradually "semiconductorize," the PCB supply chain is transforming from traditional cyclical stocks to high-growth, high-PE stocks.

From a global industry map, Taiwan, Japan, and Korea account for about 90% of high-end PCB and PCB production value, with an unbeatable technological threshold. Taiwan accounts for about 56.5%, with a deep understanding of semiconductor packaging and high-end PCB manufacturing, such as TSMC, Unitech, Taiwan's TSMC, and King Yuan Electronics, which have a global leading position in copper foil substrates and high-layer boards.

Japan accounts for about 36.3%, with a grip on high-end materials and equipment sources, such as Nittobo, which has high-end fiberglass fabric key weaving machine capacity, and Ibiden, which is a high-end IC substrate leader. South Korea accounts for about 7.2%, with companies such as Doosan actively investing in technology research and development, successfully entering the global AI chip leader's high-end PCB exclusive supply chain.

CITIC Taiwan-Japan-Korea PCB ETF (009828-TW) tracks the "NYSE TIP Taiwan-Japan-Korea PCB Index" and is priced at NT$10. It will be launched for subscription from August 17 to August 20. The index selects 30 constituent stocks, covering core PCB manufacturing, IC substrates, and upstream copper foil, fiberglass, and other key materials. As of July 31, the top 10 constituent stocks include TSMC, Unitech, Ibiden, Nittobo, JX Metals, Mitsui Metals, Zhen Ding - KY, Taiwan's TSMC, King Yuan Electronics, and Doosan.

CITIC Securities Investment Trust stated that while the short-term market may be affected by economic fluctuations or exchange rates, in the long term, the demand for high-speed transmission and high-end materials driven by AI is clear. Following the launch of the computing and power theme ETF (009819-TW) earlier, this time, 009828 is launched to help investors easily grasp the key components of Taiwan-Japan-Korea with a low threshold, packaging the AI upgrade benefits.

items.title: 白海豚颱風期間執行台海交管 航港局譴責：中共假執法、真擴權
items.title_en: White Dolphin Typhoon Enforces Taiwan Strait Traffic Control; Port Authority Condemns China’s Pseudo‑Enforcement and Power Grab
paras: 白海豚颱風已逐漸遠離台灣周邊海域，對近期中國廣東海事局以颱風影響為由，宣布對航經台灣海峽南口北上船舶實施交通管制，並要求船舶聽從其海事管理機構指揮一事。交通部航港局於今 (10) 日發布譴責，強調該局除已於第一時間即透過海岸電台等發布訊文，且據聯合國海洋法公約，中共無權對台海區域行使任何形式的控制權或管轄權，請周邊海域船舶無須理會中國海上交通管制要求，應自行規劃安全水域規避風險。

航港局指出，航港局於海上颱風警報發布前夕，即已透過新聞稿、海岸電台、船舶自動識別系統 (AIS) 等多元管道廣播周邊海域船舶防災告警，8 月 6 日更提早啟動近岸 12 浬海域警戒區淨空管制措施。並籲請航經台灣北部及東部周邊海域警戒區內船舶駛離近岸 12 浬海域警戒區避風，也協調海巡署執行必要驅離作業，同時清楚告知周邊船舶倘仍於警戒區滯留，後續將依商港法禁止進入我國各商港，因此白海豚颱風行經台灣周邊海域期間無發生任何海事案件，成功守護談台灣周邊海域船舶航行安全。
航港局再強調，針對台灣周邊海域，中華民國才是聯合國海洋法公約具法定主權之「沿岸國」，始有權對周邊船舶進行海上交通管制措施，而台灣海峽為國際水域，依據《聯合國海洋法公約》等國際規範，領海範圍外均適用國際法公海航行自由原則，中國無任何權利針對該水域之外國及我國船舶實施交通管制。
航港局也嚴正譴責中國假借颱風防災之名，遂行「假執法、真擴權、真騷擾」之不當行為。
paras_en: The White Dolphin typhoon has gradually moved away from the waters surrounding Taiwan. Recently, China’s Guangdong Maritime Safety Administration, citing the typhoon’s impact, announced traffic control for vessels sailing north through the southern mouth of the Taiwan Strait and demanded that ships obey its maritime authority. The Ministry of Transportation and Communications’ Port and Harbor Administration issued a condemnation on the 10th, stressing that it had immediately broadcast notices via coastal radio stations and, under the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea, the Chinese Communist Party has no right to exercise any form of control or jurisdiction over the Taiwan Strait area. Vessels in the surrounding waters are therefore not required to heed China’s maritime traffic control requests and should plan safe routes to avoid risk.

The Port and Harbor Administration noted that, on the eve of the maritime typhoon warning, it had already disseminated disaster‑prevention alerts to ships in nearby waters through press releases, coastal radio, and the Automatic Identification System (AIS). On August 6 it pre‑emptively activated a clearance control zone covering 12 nautical miles off the coast. It urged vessels navigating the northern and eastern Taiwan offshore warning zones to steer clear of the 12‑nautical‑mile coastal zone, coordinated with the Coast Guard Administration to carry out necessary expulsion operations, and warned that any ship remaining in the warning zone would be barred from entering Taiwan’s commercial ports under the Port Law. No maritime incidents occurred while the White Dolphin typhoon passed the surrounding waters, successfully safeguarding the safety of vessels near Taiwan.

The administration further emphasized that, regarding the waters around Taiwan, the Republic of China is the legally sovereign “coastal state” under the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea and therefore alone has the authority to impose maritime traffic‑control measures on nearby vessels. The Taiwan Strait is international waters; under the UNCLOS and other international norms, the high‑seas freedom of navigation principle applies beyond territorial seas, and China has no right to impose traffic control on foreign or Taiwanese ships in those waters.

The Port and Harbor Administration also strongly condemned China for exploiting the typhoon disaster‑prevention pretext to carry out “pseudo‑enforcement, real power expansion, and genuine harassment” of improper conduct.

items.title: 〈聯強法說〉第二季獲利質變大幅成長 AI浪潮展望樂觀旺至明年
items.title_en: Uniflex Reports Significant Profit Growth in Q2, AI Demand to Drive Future Growth
paras: 聯強 (2347-TW) 今 (10) 日舉行法人說明會，公司第二季獲利結構隨著營收顯著規模化實現質變大幅成長，單季與上半年獲利指標表現優異，聯強副總裁杜書全指出，企業對人工智慧伺服器與資料中心升級的商用剛性需求極為強勁，將持續成為帶動下半年與未來長線營運成長的核心動能。
聯強 2026 年第二季合併營收首度突破 2000 億元大關，達 2010 億元，年增 115%，季增 59%，第二季營業利益達 48 億元，年增 250%，稅後淨利 39 億元，每股純益 2.34 元，年增 197%，累計上半年合併營收達 3274 億元，年增 77%，已達去年全年營收近八成，上半年稅後淨利 68.64 億元，每股純益達 4.12 元，股東權益報酬率提升至 19%。
針對財務指標與毛利率變化，第二季毛利率降至 3.4%，主因接獲金額高達幾十億元的大型專案，專案毛利率相對較低，但營業費用率大幅下滑至 1%，使得營業利益率拉升至 2.38%，上半年營業利益率更達到 2.49% 創歷年新高，營運槓桿效益顯著。
細分產品項目，商用價值業務中以伺服器表現最為強勁，第二季營收大幅成長五倍，儲存系統與網路設備亦分別成長將近 50% 與 30%，雲端業務穩健成長 9%，家用產品方面，商用筆電與桌電成長 44%，消費型筆電成長 33%，整體電腦業務成長 37%，顯示歐美等市場具備強烈剛性需求，電競產品成長 7%，穿戴式裝置等消費電子也維持雙位數成長。
杜書全分析，AI 建置已從過去的概念驗證階段，走向企業端大規模量產部署，過去集中於大型雲端服務供應商資料中心的需求，已逐漸延伸至大型企業與工業電腦廠，帶動資料中心硬體設施與具備 AI 終端設備的升級浪潮，半導體業務更因與高階半導體及記憶體供需不平衡、價格飆漲，呈現量增價增的強勁格局。
各區域市場方面，第二季中國大陸與台灣市場營收受惠商用需求與大型專案皆呈現倍增，印尼市場成長超過 20%，紐澳市場成長 10%，香港市場 7 月份也已轉為正成長，其中中國大陸積極推動政府與國企資訊科技設備國產化，聯強深化與華為、浪潮、清華同方及信創業者合作，台灣則掌握銀行與晶片設計公司大型專案，紐澳與印尼市場的手機業務更分別實現 50% 與 72% 的高成長。
展望下半年與長線趨勢，杜書全表示，低單價手機因零組件成本上升無法推出，市場轉向中高單價產品，加上價格調漲後不易回落，價格紅利將持續發酵，下半年伴隨傳統消費旺季、AI 新算力平台與蘋果新機問世，下半年與明年營運展望保持非常樂觀，並將透過智慧供應鏈平台持續優化運作效率。
paras_en: Uniflex (2347-TW) held its investor conference today, where the company reported significant growth in its second-quarter earnings, driven by substantial scale and improved profitability. According to Uniflex Vice President Du Shuquan, the demand for AI servers and data center upgrades from enterprises is extremely strong and will continue to drive growth in the second half of the year and beyond.

Uniflex's consolidated revenue for the second quarter of 2026 exceeded NT$200 billion for the first time, reaching NT$201 billion, representing a 115% year-over-year increase and a 59% quarter-over-quarter increase. The company's operating profit for the quarter was NT$4.8 billion, up 250% year-over-year, with net profit after tax of NT$3.9 billion and earnings per share of NT$2.34, representing a 197% year-over-year increase.

In terms of financial indicators and gross margin changes, the second-quarter gross margin decreased to 3.4%, mainly due to the receipt of large-scale projects with lower margins. However, the operating expense ratio decreased significantly to 1%, resulting in an increase in the operating profit margin to 2.38%, with the first-half operating profit margin reaching a record high of 2.49%, demonstrating significant operating leverage.

Breaking down product categories, commercial products, particularly servers, showed the strongest performance, with second-quarter revenue growing fivefold. Storage systems and network equipment also grew by nearly 50% and 30%, respectively, while cloud services maintained stable growth of 9%. On the consumer side, commercial laptops and desktops grew 44%, consumer laptops grew 33%, and overall computer business grew 37%, indicating strong demand in European and American markets.

Du Shuquan analyzed that AI construction has transitioned from the concept verification stage to large-scale deployment, with demand extending from major cloud service providers to large enterprises and industrial computer manufacturers, driving an upgrade wave in data center hardware and AI-enabled devices. The semiconductor business also showed strong growth due to the imbalance between supply and demand for high-end semiconductors and memory, leading to price increases.

In terms of regional markets, second-quarter revenue in mainland China and Taiwan benefited from commercial demand and large-scale projects, with growth exceeding 20% in Indonesia, 10% in Australia and New Zealand, and 7% in Hong Kong. Uniflex has deepened its cooperation with Huawei, Inspur, Tsinghua Tongfang, and other partners in mainland China, while in Taiwan, the company has secured major projects from banks and chip design companies.

Looking ahead to the second half of the year and long-term trends, Du Shuquan expressed optimism, citing the shift towards mid-to-high-end products, price increases, and the upcoming traditional consumption season, as well as the launch of new AI platforms and Apple devices. The company will continue to optimize its operational efficiency through its smart supply chain platform.

items.title: 可成上半年獲利年增逾5成 EPS 5.14元 AI產品放量帶動營收逐月增
items.title_en: Chen Hsong Sees Over 5% YoY Profit Growth in H1 EPS of NT$5.14
paras: 機殼廠可成 (2474-TW) 今 (10) 日公告最新財報，累計今年上半年稅後純益 28.4 億元，年增逾 5 成，每股純益 5.14 元。可成指出，7 月起部分 AI 專案進入量產，隨著 AI 相關產品量產規模擴大，營收可望逐月成長。
可成第二季營收 26.81 億元，季減 29%，年減 47.3%；毛利率 28.9%，季增 0.1 個百分點，年減 1.6 個百分點；營益率 1.8%，季減 4.7 個百分點，年減 15.3 個百分點；稅後純益 13.55 億元，季減 8.7%，較去年同期由虧轉盈，每股純益 2.51 元。
可成指出，受到電子料件短缺，影響筆電產品出貨，拖累第二季營收表現，加上研發費用增加，進一步影響毛利率及營益率。
可成累計今年上半年營收 64.55 億元，年減 31.6%；毛利率 28.8%，年減 3.8 個百分點；營益率 4.5%，年減 13.5 個百分點；稅後純益 28.4 億元，年增 54.1%，每股純益 5.14 元。
展望下半年，筆電方面，可成表示，由於關鍵零組件短缺情況短期難以改善，市場普遍預期今年筆電出貨將衰退雙位數；AI 相關專案上，可成指出，7 月開始部分 AI 專案已陸續進入量產，可望帶動營收逐月成長，看好 AI 業務對於下半年營收貢獻更為顯著。
可成提到，除既有 AI 產品持續出貨，其他新開發專案預計自 2027 年第一起陸續量產，AI PC 相關產品也有望於明年第二季開始量產，屆時將進一步挹注營運成長動能。
paras_en: Chen Hsong (2474-TW) announced its latest financial report today, with a net profit of NT$2.84 billion for the first half of the year, a year-over-year increase of over 5%. The company stated that some AI projects entered mass production in July, and as the scale of AI-related product production expands, revenue is expected to grow month by month.

Chen Hsong's second-quarter revenue was NT$26.81 billion, down 29% from the previous quarter and 47.3% from the same period last year. Gross margin was 28.9%, up 0.1 percentage points from the previous quarter but down 1.6 percentage points from the same period last year. Operating margin was 1.8%, down 4.7 percentage points from the previous quarter and 15.3 percentage points from the same period last year. Net profit was NT$13.55 billion, down 8.7% from the previous quarter but turned from a loss to a profit compared to the same period last year, with EPS of NT$2.51.

Chen Hsong attributed the second-quarter revenue performance to the shortage of electronic components, which affected laptop shipments, and increased research and development expenses, which further impacted gross margin and operating margin.

Chen Hsong's revenue for the first half of the year was NT$64.55 billion, down 31.6% from the same period last year. Gross margin was 28.8%, down 3.8 percentage points from the same period last year. Operating margin was 4.5%, down 13.5 percentage points from the same period last year. Net profit was NT$2.84 billion, up 54.1% from the same period last year, with EPS of NT$5.14.

Looking ahead to the second half of the year, Chen Hsong stated that the shortage of key components is unlikely to be resolved in the short term, and the market expects laptop shipments to decline by double digits this year. However, the company is optimistic about the contribution of AI-related business to revenue growth in the second half of the year.

Chen Hsong mentioned that, in addition to existing AI products, new projects are expected to enter mass production starting from the first quarter of 2027, and AI PC-related products are expected to enter mass production in the second quarter of next year, which will further inject growth momentum into the business.

items.title_en: Three Major Futures Exceeds Last Year's Full-Year Profit in First Half of 2026, EPS Reaches 0.63 Yuan
paras: 三大未來 (7761-TW) 今 (10) 日公布 2026 年上半年財報。受惠二次鋰電池處理量增加、產能利用率提升及再生料銷售表現穩健，2026 年上半年營收達 1.41 億元，稅後純益 1808 萬元，年成長 63%，每股 0.63 元。受惠營運規模持續擴大及獲利能力提升，上半年稅後純益已超越 2025 年全年水準。
公司展望，預期 2026 年下半年營運及獲利表現可望優於上半年
三大未來 2026 上半年處理量能穩定提升，電動車電池處理量較去年同期成長近八倍，二次鋰電池平均稼動率也由去年同期的 41% 提升至 50%；此外，上半年倫敦金屬交易所（LME）的鈷金屬平均報價較去年同期上揚，帶動再生料銷售收入成長，推升整體營收表現。隨著營收規模穩健擴大，在營業費用維持穩定下，上半年平均毛利率、營業利益率及稅後淨利率均較去年同期明顯改善，帶動整體獲利成長。
三大未來表示，目前二次鋰電池產能利用率約 5 成，隨著回收來源持續擴大，電動車電池處理量穩定增加，上半年電動車電池相關業務獲利貢獻比重達 2.1%，隨著車廠退役電池回收處理需求持續增加，以及大型鋰電池回收案件逐步放量，預期下半年產能利用率將持續提升，並進一步發揮規模經濟效益。
展望 2026 年下半年，三大未來表示，下半年將持續聚焦於產能利用率及製程效率的提升，拓展電動車與大型鋰電池回收業務，深化與車廠、3C 業者及事業單位的合作，並進一步強化再生料銷售及成本控管，在產能利用率持續提升，穩健推動營運成長。
三大未來公司表示，電池回收處理費以及再生料銷售收入仍為下半年主要營運成長動能，且隨著廢電池回收處理量持續提升，再生料價格維持相對有利，以及屏東佳冬廠產能效益逐步發揮，預期下半年營運及獲利表現可望優於上半年，全年營運展望維持審慎樂觀。
paras_en: Three Major Futures (7761-TW) announced its 2026 first-half financial report today (10). Benefiting from the increase in secondary lithium battery processing volume, improved production capacity utilization rate, and stable performance of recycled material sales, the company's revenue reached NT$ 14.1 billion, net profit after tax NT$ 180.8 million, with a year-on-year growth of 63%, and EPS of 0.63 yuan. Benefiting from the continuous expansion of operating scale and improved profitability, the company's net profit after tax in the first half has exceeded the full-year level of 2025.
The company's outlook is that the operating and profitability performance in the second half of 2026 is expected to be better than the first half.

Three Major Futures' 2026 first-half processing volume is expected to remain stable, with electric vehicle battery processing volume growing nearly eightfold compared to the same period last year, and the average utilization rate of secondary lithium batteries also increased from 41% last year to 50%. In addition, the average price of cobalt metal on the London Metal Exchange (LME) in the first half of the year was higher than the same period last year, driving the growth of recycled material sales revenue and pushing up overall revenue performance. As the revenue scale has been steadily expanded, with operating expenses remaining stable, the company's average gross margin, operating profit margin, and net profit margin have all improved significantly compared to the same period last year, driving overall profitability growth.

Three Major Futures stated that the current utilization rate of secondary lithium battery production capacity is around 50%, and as the source of recycled materials continues to expand, the processing volume of electric vehicle batteries is expected to remain stable, with the contribution rate of electric vehicle battery-related business reaching 2.1% in the first half. As the demand for retired electric vehicle battery recycling and processing continues to increase, and large-scale lithium battery recycling projects are gradually put into production, it is expected that the utilization rate will continue to improve in the second half, and further scale economies will be realized.

Looking ahead to the second half of 2026, Three Major Futures stated that it will continue to focus on improving production capacity utilization and process efficiency, expanding electric vehicle and large-scale lithium battery recycling businesses, deepening cooperation with automakers, 3C industry players, and business units, and further strengthening recycled material sales and cost control. As production capacity utilization continues to improve, the company expects to maintain stable growth in operating performance.

Three Major Futures stated that battery recycling processing fees and recycled material sales revenue will remain the main drivers of operating growth in the second half, and as the volume of waste battery recycling continues to increase, recycled material prices remain relatively favorable, and the efficiency of the Pingtung Jiadong Plant continues to improve, the company expects the operating and profitability performance in the second half to be better than the first half, with a cautious and optimistic outlook for the full year.

items.title: PCB變身印「鈔」電路板！中信009828卡位龍頭商機 看好台股今年還有高點
items.title_en: CITIC Transforms into Printing "Money" Circuit Boards! CITIC 009828 Seizes Market Opportunity, Sees High Points in Taiwan Stock Market This Year
paras: 全球 AI 伺服器、高速運算 (HPC) 及資料中心建置需求爆發，市場投資焦點已從單純的晶片與伺服器組裝，延伸至最核心的關鍵基礎設施—印刷電路板 (PCB) 與上游高階材料。瞄準此波規格升級商機，中國信託投信推出國內首檔聚焦台日韓 PCB 產業龍頭的「中信台日韓 PCB ETF(009828-TW)」，指數精選 30 檔成分股，台光電、欣興為前二大持股。經理人指出，台股短期拉回正是消化壓力、蓄積能量的良機，隨著下半年 AI 新平台拉貨潮與旺季效益發酵，台股基本面利多不變，「今年絕對還有高點可期」。
台股日前遭遇血腥 7 月，崩跌逾 3000 點，009828 擬任經理人葉松炫強調，雖然台股經歷洗盤與波動，但這僅是籌碼面的短期修正，絕非基本面轉弱。他指出，在 AI 硬體強勁需求與規格升級循環的紮實支撐下，隨著融資浮碼清洗乾淨，市場評價與動能隨時會迎來強烈的「V 轉」。

PCB 素有「電子元件之母」之稱，負責承載晶片並連接電子訊號，廣泛應用於手機、車用電子、家電、AI 伺服器與高效能運算設備。葉松炫指出，PCB 過去被視為近 20 年規格未有重大變革的景氣循環產業，但在 AI 時代已躍升為影響系統效能與穩定度的關鍵零組件。在 NVIDIA 等晶片巨頭提出的技術手冊推動下，PCB 的傳輸速度要求從過去的「台鐵」一路提升至「高鐵」乃至「光鐵」(光傳輸)，層數也從傳統 13 層倍增至 26 層以上，技術規格每 1 至 1.5 年即面臨一次升級。

葉松炫以歷史聞名的「淘金熱」為例指出，淘金客不一定能賺大錢，但提供鏟子、鐵軌與設備的「賣鏟者」永遠獲利穩定，在 AI 的巨大浪潮中，高階 PCB 及其上游材料正是典型的「賣鏟者」。根據高盛預估，2025 年至 2027 年 AI PCB 市場規模年複合成長率 (CAGR) 將達 140%，AI 銅箔基板市場更上看 179%。隨產品逐步「半導體化」，PCB 供應鏈正從傳統景氣循環股，華麗轉身為高成長、高本益比評價的科技成長股。
從全球產業版圖來看，台日韓三地高階載板與 PCB 產值占全球約九成，擁有不可替代的技術門檻，其中台灣占比約 56.5%，深耕半導體封裝與高階 PCB 製造，如台光電、欣興、台燿、金像電等，在銅箔基板 (CCL) 與高層數板具備全球領先地位。
日本占比約 36.3%，掌握高階材料與設備源頭，如日東紡織 (Nittobo) 握有高階玻纖布關鍵織布機產能，揖斐電 (Ibiden) 則為高階 IC 載板龍頭。韓國占比約 7.2%，如斗山集團 (Doosan) 等企業積極投入技術研發，成功打入全球 AI 晶片龍頭的高階 PCB 獨家供應鏈。
中信台日韓 PCB ETF(009828-TW) 追蹤「NYSE TIP 台日韓 PCB 指數」，發行價 10 元，將於 8 月 17 日至 8 月 20 日展開募集。指數精選 30 檔成分股，涵蓋核心 PCB 製造、IC 載板及上游銅箔、玻纖布等關鍵材料。截至 7 月 31 日，前十大成分股包含台光電、欣興、揖斐電、日東電工、JX 金屬、三井金屬、臻鼎 - KY、台燿、金像電及斗山集團。
中國信託投信表示，短線市場雖受景氣波動或匯率影響，但中長期而言，AI 帶動的高速傳輸與高階材料需求明確。繼先前推出的算力與電力主題 ETF(009819-TW) 後，此次推出 009828，盼協助投資人以低門檻輕鬆擁有一手掌握台日韓關鍵零組件龍頭的投資利器，完整打包 AI 升級紅利。
paras_en: The global demand for AI servers, high-performance computing (HPC), and data center construction has exploded, shifting market investment focus from simple chip and server assembly to the most critical infrastructure - printed circuit boards (PCB) and upstream high-end materials. CITIC Securities Investment Trust has launched the first domestic Taiwan-Japan-Korea PCB industry-focused ETF (009828-TW), which selects 30 constituent stocks, with Taiwan's TSMC and Unitech as the top two major shareholders. The fund manager pointed out that the recent short-term pullback in the Taiwan stock market is a good opportunity to digest pressure and accumulate energy, and with the AI new platform shipment wave and peak season effect kicking in, the Taiwan stock market's fundamental advantages remain unchanged, "This year, there will definitely be a high point to look forward to."

The Taiwan stock market recently experienced a bloody July, plummeting over 3,000 points, but CITIC Securities Investment Trust's fund manager, Ye Songxuan, emphasized that this is only a short-term correction on the capital account, not a weakening of the fundamental situation. He pointed out that under the solid support of AI hardware demand and specification upgrade cycles, with the clearing of financing floating stocks, the market's valuation and momentum will soon experience a strong "V-turn".

PCB is known as the "mother of electronic components," responsible for carrying chips and connecting electronic signals, widely used in smartphones, automotive electronics, home appliances, AI servers, and high-performance computing equipment. Ye Songxuan pointed out that PCB was previously considered a 20-year industry with no major specification changes, but in the AI era, it has become a critical component that affects system performance and stability. Under the driving of NVIDIA and other chip giants' technical manuals, PCB's transmission speed requirements have been upgraded from "bullet train" to "high-speed rail" and even "light rail" (optical transmission), and the number of layers has increased from the traditional 13 layers to 26 layers or more, with technical specifications facing upgrades every 1-1.5 years.

Ye Songxuan used the historical example of the "gold rush" to point out that gold prospectors may not necessarily make a fortune, but the "seller of shovels" who provides pickaxes, rail tracks, and equipment will always reap stable profits. In the massive AI wave, high-end PCBs and their upstream materials are typical "sellers of shovels." According to Goldman Sachs' estimates, the AI PCB market will grow at a compound annual growth rate (CAGR) of 140% from 2025 to 2027, while the AI copper foil substrate market will grow even faster at 179%. As products gradually "semiconductorize," the PCB supply chain is transforming from traditional cyclical stocks to high-growth, high-PE stocks.

From a global industry map, Taiwan, Japan, and Korea account for about 90% of high-end PCB and PCB production value, with an unbeatable technological threshold. Taiwan accounts for about 56.5%, with a deep understanding of semiconductor packaging and high-end PCB manufacturing, such as TSMC, Unitech, Taiwan's TSMC, and King Yuan Electronics, which have a global leading position in copper foil substrates and high-layer boards.

Japan accounts for about 36.3%, with a grip on high-end materials and equipment sources, such as Nittobo, which has high-end fiberglass fabric key weaving machine capacity, and Ibiden, which is a high-end IC substrate leader. South Korea accounts for about 7.2%, with companies such as Doosan actively investing in technology research and development, successfully entering the global AI chip leader's high-end PCB exclusive supply chain.

CITIC Taiwan-Japan-Korea PCB ETF (009828-TW) tracks the "NYSE TIP Taiwan-Japan-Korea PCB Index" and is priced at NT$10. It will be launched for subscription from August 17 to August 20. The index selects 30 constituent stocks, covering core PCB manufacturing, IC substrates, and upstream copper foil, fiberglass, and other key materials. As of July 31, the top 10 constituent stocks include TSMC, Unitech, Ibiden, Nittobo, JX Metals, Mitsui Metals, Zhen Ding - KY, Taiwan's TSMC, King Yuan Electronics, and Doosan.

CITIC Securities Investment Trust stated that while the short-term market may be affected by economic fluctuations or exchange rates, in the long term, the demand for high-speed transmission and high-end materials driven by AI is clear. Following the launch of the computing and power theme ETF (009819-TW) earlier, this time, 009828 is launched to help investors easily grasp the key components of Taiwan-Japan-Korea with a low threshold, packaging the AI upgrade benefits.

items.title_en: Net Profit Doubles to $25.67 B Yet Still Short? Michael Burry, the Real‑Life ‘Big Short’ Figure, No Longer Sees Berkshire as an Attractive Investment
paras: 好萊塢電影《大賣空》原型人物、知名投資人 Michael Burry 上週表示，當初最擔心「股神」巴菲特退位後繼任者「年紀偏大、終究不是巴菲特，沒那種只揮最佳一棒耐心」的話已經成真，並指波克夏海瑟威未來不再是有吸引力的投資。
話音落下隔日，波克夏剛交出一份「數字很亮眼、敘事很微妙」的 2026 年 Q2 財報。
根據波克夏上週六 (8 日) 披露的財報成績單，該公司 Q2 歸屬於股東淨利 256.7 億美元，較去年同期 123.7 億幾近翻倍，主因權益投資未實現收益回彈。剔除此項目後，營業利潤 129.8 億美元，年增 16.3%，其中製造、服務與零售組合利潤成長 24% 至 44.7 億美元，Geico 拖累保險承保利潤下滑。
巴菲特以往屢屢提醒說：「淨利受公允價值波動干擾，營業利潤才是本業溫度計。
真正讓市場側目的是「錢開始動了」。今年 Q2 波克夏買股 235 億、賣股 37 億，三年多來首度股票淨買入，且同步回購 A 股 478 股、B 股逾 800 萬股，耗資約 45 億美元，較今年 Q1 的 2.34 億明顯加碼，但仍低於市場 50-110 億預期。

今年 1 月，巴菲特交出 60 年權杖，阿貝爾 (Greg Abel) 正式上任波克夏執行長一職、巴菲特留任董事長。
Burry 質疑的正是這道縫隙：阿貝爾肯不肯像巴菲特那樣「忍住不買」，但反方論點認為 Q2 營業利潤雙位數增、現金開始流向回購與淨買股、前五大持倉 (蘋果、美國運通、美銀、可口可樂、Alphabet) 仍緊抱現金流龍頭。
Lountzis 資產管理總裁 Paul Lountzis 則表示，私募市場目前非常瘋狂、公開市場也有些不理性，「很難要求阿貝爾現在進行巨型交易」，投資人仍願給時間。

paras_en: Hollywood film “The Big Short” was based on Michael Burry, a well‑known investor, who said last week that his biggest worry – that after Warren Buffett steps down his successor would be “older, not Buffett, and lack the patience to swing the best bat” – has already come true, and he now views Berkshire Hathaway as no longer an attractive investment.
The day after his comments, Berkshire just released a 2026 Q2 earnings report that was “numerically impressive but narratively subtle.”

According to the earnings slip Berkshire disclosed on Saturday (the 8th), its Q2 net profit attributable to shareholders was $25.67 billion, almost double the $12.37 billion a year earlier, driven mainly by a rebound in unrealized gains on equity investments. Excluding that item, operating profit was $12.98 billion, up 16.3% year‑over‑year, with manufacturing, services and retail contributing $4.47 billion – a 24% rise – while Geico weighed on insurance underwriting profit.
Buffett has repeatedly warned that “net profit is distorted by fair‑value fluctuations; operating profit is the true temperature gauge of the business.”

What really caught the market’s eye was that “the money started moving.” In Q2 this year Berkshire bought $23.5 billion of stock and sold $3.7 billion, marking the first net stock purchase in more than three years, and simultaneously repurchased 478 million Class A shares and over 8 million Class B shares for about $4.5 billion – a clear step‑up from the $2.34 billion in Q1, though still below analysts’ $5‑$11 billion expectations.

As of the end of June, Berkshire’s cash and U.S. Treasury holdings stood at $364.7 billion, down 4% quarter‑over‑quarter – the first decline in four years. In the same period the company also spent $6.8 billion to acquire homebuilder Taylor Morrison (closing in July, not reflected in Q2 results) and signed a private‑placement agreement for $10 billion of the $80 billion Google financing deal.
In January this year Buffett passed the 60‑year baton to Greg Abel, who officially became Berkshire’s CEO while Buffett remains chairman.

Burry’s criticism targets that very gap: whether Abel will exercise the same restraint Buffett showed by “holding back on buying.” Opponents argue that Q2 operating profit grew double‑digits, cash is flowing into buybacks and net stock purchases, and the top five holdings – Apple, American Express, Bank of America, Coca‑Cola and Alphabet – remain tightly tied to cash‑flow powerhouses.

Paul Lountzis, president of Lountzis Asset Management, said the private‑equity market is currently “very crazy” and the public market is somewhat irrational, making it “hard to demand that Abel execute massive deals right now,” and investors are still willing to give him time.

Berkshire’s stock rose only 4.28% in Q2, lagging the S&P 500’s 14.87% gain – Burry’s cool assessment and the market’s hesitation stem from the same issue: after the legend hands over the reins, the market no longer wants “the next Buffett,” but proof that Abel can deliver strong results even with $364.7 billion on the balance sheet.

items.title: 日月光投控7月營收738億元 年增43%飆單月新高
items.title_en: Jabil Circuit 7M Revenue Hits NT$73.8B, Up 43% YoY
paras: 封測龍頭日月光投控 (3711-TW)(ASX-US) 今 (10) 日公布 7 月營收 737.84 億元，月增 12.16%，年增 43.15%，累計前 7 月營收 4,385.09 億元，年增 25.13%；受惠先進封裝與傳統打線封裝雙雙熱絡，日月光投控 7 月營收首度突破 700 億元大關，一舉創下歷史新高。
觀察封測及材料業務營收，日月光投控受惠產能利用率持續攀升，加上漲價效應陸續發酵，7 月業績達 475.24 億元，月增 9.3%，年增 49.5%。
由於 AI 先進封裝需求持續強勁，日月光投控看好，今年 LEAP 先進封裝服務營收將優於原先 35 億美元目標，並預期在新增廠房與設備陸續到位後，2027 年 LEAP 營收可望較今年再翻倍。
為因應客戶強勁訂單，日月光投控今年資本支出預計衝破百億美元，達 105 億美元，較先前的 85 億美元，上調 23.5%，再度創下歷史新高，並預期明年同樣會維持高檔，以維持公司在先進封裝與先進測試的領先地位。
paras_en: Jabil Circuit (3711-TW) (JBL-US) today announced 7M revenue of NT$73.8 billion, up 12.16% MoM and 43.15% YoY, with a total of NT$438.5 billion in revenue for the first 7 months, up 25.13% YoY. The company's revenue exceeded NT$70 billion for the first time, setting a new historical high.
Jabil Circuit's revenue from testing and materials business reached NT$47.5 billion in 7M, up 9.3% MoM and 49.5% YoY, driven by increased utilization rates and price increases.

Due to strong demand for AI advanced packaging, Jabil Circuit is optimistic about its LEAP advanced packaging service revenue, which is expected to exceed the initial target of $3.5 billion and potentially double in 2027 after the addition of new facilities and equipment.

To meet strong customer orders, Jabil Circuit is expected to increase its capital expenditure to $10.5 billion this year, up 23.5% from the initial target of $8.5 billion, setting a new historical high. The company also expects to maintain a high level of capital expenditure next year to maintain its leading position in advanced packaging and testing.

items.title: 五角大廈要求國防巨頭加速生產以補充庫存
items.title_en: Pentagon Urges Defense Giants to Accelerate Production to Address Stockpile Shortages
paras: 隨著與伊朗的衝突持續加劇，美國五角大廈正向國內主要國防承包商施壓，要求其縮短武器開發周期並大幅擴大產能，以應對軍火庫存日益枯竭的壓力。
美國國防部副部長 Steve Feinberg 於 8 月 5 日致函波音 (BA-US)、洛克希德馬丁 (LMT-US) 及 RTX Corp (RTC-US) 等大廠，明確表示「長達數年的開發周期已不可接受」，軍方必須立即加速計畫時程。
此次加速生產的要求主要涵蓋廣域監控設備、防空感測器、飛彈攔截器及飛彈追蹤系統。
據報導，美軍在對抗伊朗及其代理人的行動中，因頻繁攔截攻擊美國基地與盟友的無人機與飛彈，導致彈藥儲備面臨嚴峻挑戰。專家指出，美軍已在相關衝突中消耗至少一半的「愛國者」飛彈庫存，這不僅影響自身戰備，也迫使美國在支援烏克蘭等盟友的軍援分配上做出艱難選擇。
除了應對當前戰場需求，Feinberg 在信中也強調了長期戰略項目的重要性，包括衛星通訊、次世代防空系統及洛克希德馬丁的「次世代攔截器」(Next Generation Interceptor)，後者旨在汰換舊型組件以強化本土防禦跨洲際彈道飛彈的能力。
其他被點名的優先項目還包括 RTX 的海軍 AN/SPY-6 雷達、Leidos 的長程監控網路，以及波音的 T-7A 教練機等。
儘管總統川普公開否認美國彈藥短缺，並宣稱擁有「巨量」儲備，但他也坦承部分系統的供應「稍微吃緊」，正每日補給中。
為了支撐龐大的產能需求，五角大廈正尋求 182 億美元的追加戰爭資金，並要求承包商於 8 月底前提交具體的加速交付計畫，說明如何透過增加人力與擴建設施來支持「更高容量且持續的訂單」。
paras_en: As tensions with Iran continue to escalate, the Pentagon is pressuring its top defense contractors to shorten development timelines and significantly increase production capacity to address growing pressure on dwindling stockpiles.

On August 5, Deputy Defense Secretary Steve Feinberg wrote to Boeing (BA-US), Lockheed Martin (LMT-US), and RTX Corp (RTC-US) and other major manufacturers, stating that "development timelines of several years are unacceptable" and that the military must immediately accelerate project timelines.
The accelerated production request primarily covers wide-area surveillance systems, air defense sensors, missile interceptors, and missile tracking systems.

According to reports, the US military has consumed at least half of its "Patriot" missile stockpile in its actions against Iran and its proxies, leaving ammunition reserves facing a severe challenge. Experts note that this has not only affected US military readiness but has also forced the US to make difficult decisions in allocating military aid to allies such as Ukraine.

In addition to addressing current battlefield needs, Feinberg emphasized the importance of long-term strategic projects, including satellite communications, next-generation air defense systems, and Lockheed Martin's "Next Generation Interceptor," which aims to replace old components to enhance the ability to defend against intercontinental ballistic missiles.
Other priority projects mentioned include RTX's Navy AN/SPY-6 radar, Leidos' long-range monitoring network, and Boeing's T-7A trainer.

Despite President Trump publicly denying US ammunition shortages and claiming to have "vast" reserves, he also acknowledged that some systems' supplies are "a bit tight" and are being replenished daily.

To support the massive production demands, the Pentagon is seeking an additional $182 billion in war funding and is requiring contractors to submit specific accelerated delivery plans by the end of August, outlining how they will support "higher capacity and sustained orders" through increased personnel and expanded facilities.

items.title: OpenAI「GPT-6」Astra傳8月登場！10兆參數、代號「Doug」模型年底再戰
items.title_en: OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra Expected to Launch in August, 10 Trillion Parameters, Codenamed 'Doug' Model to Debut by Year-End
paras: 社群平台 X 近日流傳一系列關於 OpenAI 下一代模型的消息。儘管公司近期才因故緊急暫停過該模型的推出計畫，但爆料指出，代號「Astra」的新模型，外界普遍推測即為「GPT-6」，可能在本月內發布。
截至目前，OpenAI 官方尚未證實任何相關細節，這些消息均來自社群帳號與業界觀察者的推測與二手訊息。
爆料帳號「ChrisGPT」宣稱，Astra 的參數規模可能達到約十兆，若屬實，將是外界普遍估算 GPT-4（約 1.8 兆參數）的五倍以上。
消息也連結到 OpenAI 總裁 Greg Brockman 近期在 X 上轉發的一則貼文，內容提及 GPT-4 的訓練工作是在四年前的 8 月 8 日完成，這個時間點的巧合，被部分網友解讀為 GPT-6 可能選在相近檔期發布的訊號。
若參數規模真如傳言大幅躍升，業界普遍認為新模型在邏輯推理與泛化能力上理應會有顯著提升，但目前並無獨立可信來源證實具體數字，一切仍停留在猜測階段。
除了 Astra，社群消息還指向另一個代號「Doug」的專案，據稱規模將遠超今年稍早發布的 Fable 5，且並非 GPT-6 本身，而是預計最快在 11 月前推出的獨立訓練成果。
研究機構 SemiAnalysis 此前也曾提及這個代號，市場分析人士 Pankaj Kumar 則推測，「Doug」很可能採用輝達 (NVDA-US) 尚未全面量產的次世代 Vera Rubin 晶片進行訓練。
這類傳聞若屬實，代表 OpenAI 正打算在下半年連續推出兩款重量級模型：先以 Astra 搶佔 8 月的市場聲量，再於年底以「Doug」衝擊技術指標，試圖鞏固業界領先地位。
但同樣地，這些細節目前僅止於業界傳聞，尚待官方證實。
部分評論指出，這一連串傳聞背後隱含一個更值得關注的產業現象：自 2024 年 5 月 GPT-4o 發布以來，OpenAI 已逾兩年未完成新一代尖端模型的全規模預訓練。
外界普遍認為，包括 o1、o3 到 GPT-5 系列在內的更新，多半是建立在 GPT-4o 既有基礎上進行後訓練與強化學習，而非從零打造新的模型底座。
也有消息稱，先前部分內部專案曾因表現未達預期而遭降級處理，但公司內部並未放棄推進大規模預訓練的方向；直到 Google(GOOGL-US) 去年底推出 Gemini 3 後，才促使 OpenAI 加速換代決心，並衍生出代號「Garlic」的驗證性專案，以及規模更大的「Doug」。
若消息屬實，這也呼應了業界長期爭論的「擴展定律（Scaling Law）是否已經失效」議題。
不過，SemiAnalysis 認為，只要運算資源與資料量持續擴大，模型效能仍有機會如預期般提升。
就在這波傳聞延燒之際，Google 也出現重大人事震盪。當地時間 8 月 5 日，任職 27 年的首席科學家 Jeff Dean 據報與三名核心研究員一同離職創業。
同一天，Google DeepMind 共同創辦人、諾貝爾獎得主哈薩比斯（Demis Hassabis）也宣布卸下執行長職務，轉任董事長。受此消息影響，母公司 Alphabet 股價當日一度下跌逾 4%。
這起人事變動被部分觀察者視為指標性事件，象徵原本被視為「三強鼎立」的生成式 AI 競賽格局，如今實質上僅剩 OpenAI 與 Anthropic 兩大陣營持續正面交鋒。
面對 Astra 可能來勢洶洶，市場也傳出 Anthropic 正籌劃在 8 月推出「Fable 5.1」，定價比照現行的 Fable 5，被視為直接對標 Astra 的策略性回應。
有觀察意見認為，Anthropic 稍早發布 Opus 5 時刻意保留部分技術實力，可能就是為了替 Fable 5.1 預留後手，一旦 OpenAI 新模型亮相，便能迅速跟進反制。
不過，這類「田忌賽馬」式的產品布局說法，同樣僅為市場推測，Anthropic 官方尚未對外證實相關發布計畫或時程。
paras_en: A series of rumors about OpenAI's next-generation model has been circulating on social media platforms. Although the company recently suspended the release plan for the model due to unforeseen circumstances, insiders claim that the codenamed 'Astra' model, widely speculated to be 'GPT-6', may be released as early as this month.
As of now, OpenAI has not officially confirmed any details, and these rumors come from social media accounts and industry observers' speculations and second-hand information.
The 'ChrisGPT' account claims that Astra's parameter scale may reach around 10 trillion, which would be more than five times the parameter scale of GPT-4 (approximately 1.8 trillion parameters).

The rumors are also linked to OpenAI CEO Greg Brockman's recent post on X, which mentions that GPT-4's training work was completed on August 8, 2023. This coincidence has been interpreted by some netizens as a signal that GPT-6 may be released around the same time.

If the parameter scale is indeed significantly increased, the industry generally believes that the new model should have a significant improvement in logical reasoning and generalization capabilities. However, there is currently no independent, reliable source to confirm the specific numbers, and everything remains in the speculation stage.

In addition to Astra, social media rumors also point to another codenamed 'Doug' project, which is said to be much larger than the recently released Fable 5 and is not GPT-6 itself, but rather an independent training result expected to be released as early as November.

Research institution SemiAnalysis has previously mentioned this codename, and market analyst Pankaj Kumar speculates that 'Doug' may use NVIDIA's (NVDA-US) next-generation Vera Rubin chip, which has not yet been fully mass-produced, for training.

If these rumors are true, it would mean that OpenAI is planning to release two heavyweight models in the second half of the year: first, Astra will grab market attention in August, and then 'Doug' will make a splash in December, aiming to solidify its leading position in the industry.
However, these details are currently only industry rumors and await official confirmation.

Some commentators point out that behind these rumors lies a more significant industry phenomenon: since GPT-4 was released in May 2024, OpenAI has been over two years without completing the full-scale pre-training of a new generation of advanced models.

The industry generally believes that updates, including o1, o3, and GPT-5, are mostly built on the existing foundation of GPT-4 and are subject to further training and reinforcement learning, rather than creating a new model base from scratch.

There are also rumors that some internal projects were downgraded due to underperformance, but the company has not given up on pushing forward with large-scale pre-training. It was not until Google (GOOGL-US) released Gemini 3 at the end of last year that OpenAI accelerated its upgrade plans and spawned the verification project codenamed 'Garlic' and the larger 'Doug'.
If the rumors are true, this would also echo the long-debated 'Scaling Law' issue in the industry.
However, SemiAnalysis believes that as long as computational resources and data volume continue to expand, model performance may still improve as expected.

Just as these rumors are raging, Google has experienced a significant personnel shake-up. On August 5, local time, Chief Scientist Jeff Dean, who has been with the company for 27 years, reportedly left with three core researchers to start a new company.

On the same day, Google DeepMind co-founder and Nobel laureate Demis Hassabis announced his resignation as CEO and took over as chairman. The news caused Alphabet's stock price to drop by over 4% on the same day.

This personnel change has been seen by some observers as a landmark event, symbolizing the fact that the originally perceived 'three-strong' generative AI competition landscape has now effectively narrowed down to OpenAI and Anthropic, with the two giants facing off against each other.

In the face of Astra's possible arrival, the market has also heard that Anthropic is planning to release 'Fable 5.1' in August, priced similarly to the current Fable 5, which is seen as a strategic response to directly target Astra.

Some observers believe that Anthropic deliberately reserved some technical capabilities when releasing Opus 5 earlier, which may be a reserve for Fable 5.1, allowing them to quickly follow up and counterattack once OpenAI's new model is released.
However, this 'Tianji racing horses' style product layout is also just market speculation, and Anthropic has not officially confirmed any release plans or schedules.

items.title: 黃仁勳罕見開口挺AI開源！一封公開信炸出矽谷「開源vs閉源」兩大陣營博弈
items.title_en: NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang Rarely Speaks Out in Support of AI Open-Source, Sparking a Valley-Wide Debate on Open-Source vs Closed-Source
paras: 輝達 (NVDA-US) 執行長黃仁勳罕見聲援「開放權重」AI 模型，短短數天便吸引 70 多家企業與 AI 業界人士聯署，讓開放與封閉模型兩大陣營正式浮上檯面。這場看似技術路線之爭，背後其實牽動晶片、雲端、模型與 AI 應用的利益重新分配。
一向低調、鮮少在社群媒體上表態的黃仁勳，日前罕見地在 X 上發出他個人的第一則貼文，內容直接聲援一封題為《開放權重與美國 AI 領導力》（Open Weights and American AI Leadership）的聯署公開信。
這封信在短短數天內，聯署企業數量便從最初的 25 家暴增至 70 餘家，累積閱讀量突破 6000 萬次，也讓外界首次清楚看見，矽谷 AI 產業在「開放模型」與「封閉模型」兩條路線上，已形成壁壘分明的兩大陣營。
這封公開信的訴求相當直接：呼籲業界共同支持「開放權重」模型的發展，並反對監管單位對開源 AI 模型採取一刀切式的限制。
分析指出，這表面上看似只是一次產業倡議，但實際上內容直指幾個關鍵議題，包括防止新創企業被單一模型供應商綁定、將競爭從模型層擴大到雲端與晶片層、主張技術透明度有助於安全治理，以及為「知識蒸餾」（利用大型模型的輸出訓練較小模型）技術辯護，強調這是研究上行之有年的正當做法，不應被視為侵權或竊取。
信中傳達的核心立場，可以歸納為一句話：監管機構不應該為了防範尚未發生的風險，而限制開放權重這條技術路線的發展空間。
微軟 (MSFT-US) 執行長納德拉（Satya Nadella）、特斯拉 (TSLA-US) 執行長馬斯克、圖靈獎得主楊立昆（Yann LeCun），以及 AI 學者吳恩達（Andrew Ng）等重量級人物皆列名聲援，陣容堪稱近年 AI 圈規模最大的一次集體表態。

各懷盤算：誰在支持開源，為了什麼

觀察這份聯署名單背後的企業組成，不難發現這其實是一場關於 AI 產業鏈利潤分配的角力，各方支持開源都有各自的商業考量。
晶片與硬體廠商如輝達、戴爾科技 (DELL-US) ，最在意的是算力需求能否持續擴張。當愈來愈多企業選擇自行部署與微調開放權重模型，硬體採購與雲端算力的需求也會隨之水漲船高，這正是輝達力挺開源的根本動機。
微軟、Palantir(PLTR-US) 等雲端服務與企業軟體業者，則希望藉由開放權重模型豐富自家雲端平台的產品線，讓企業客戶不必被單一 API 供應商綁定，進而把客戶留在自己的雲端與訂閱服務生態中。
以 Meta(META-US) 為首的開源陣營與生態基礎設施業者，則是希望透過開放模型（如 Llama 系列）掌握技術標準的主導權；Mistral、Hugging Face 等新創公司也藉此爭取原本被閉源巨頭壟斷的企業客戶。
而創投圈如 a16z、YC 等機構，則擔心若底層模型長期被少數閉源公司把持，應用層新創的獲利空間將被大幅壓縮，因此力挺開放權重，以確保新創公司在成本與商業模式上仍有議價空間。

Anthropic 缺席聯署 立場鮮明成為焦點

值得注意的是，在這波近乎「集體站隊」的聲勢中，Anthropic 的缺席格外顯眼。
作為閉源陣營的代表性企業，Anthropic 不僅未加入聯署，其員工 Julian 更在 X 上公開對開源陣營表達不以為然的態度，直接引發吳恩達的回應。
吳恩達表示，任何公司都有權利選擇不公開自己的程式碼，但沒有立場去阻止其他人選擇開源。
外界普遍認為，Anthropic 對開放權重的保留態度，與其商業模式高度相關。
該公司的營收與估值，很大程度建立在模型能力的稀缺性之上。一旦市場上出現足以替代的開源模型，其 API 訂價的溢價空間與資本市場對其成長性的想像，都可能受到衝擊。而監管政策未來如何拿捏，也仍是開源陣營必須持續面對的變數。

模型走向「基礎設施化」，應用層成新戰場

分析稱，隨著開源模型的性能持續逼近甚至部分超越閉源模型，業界觀察普遍認為，底層大型語言模型正逐漸「基礎設施化」，也就是逐漸成為低成本、高普及的公共資源，單靠堆疊參數規模已難以構成長期競爭優勢。
在這樣的趨勢下，產業利潤可能會朝兩端集中：一端是輝達等掌握運算基礎設施的硬體廠商；另一端則是能將 AI 技術與企業真實資料、業務流程及智慧代理（Agent）深度結合的應用層公司。
與此同時，企業客戶對資料主權與技術安全性的重視程度提高，也讓「參數規模較小、可私有化部署、性能貼近實際需求」的垂直領域模型，加上端側運算裝置（如 AI PC、AI 手機）的普及，被部分業界人士視為下一階段較具確定性的商業化方向。
這場開放與封閉路線之爭，短期內恐怕難有定論。但對整個 AI 產業而言，這場公開的路線辯論，某種程度上也標誌著這個產業正式告別野蠻生長的早期階段，進入規則與利益重新分配的新局面。
paras_en: NVIDIA (NVDA-US) CEO Jensen Huang has rarely spoken out in support of open-source AI models, but his recent endorsement has sparked a valley-wide debate on open-source vs closed-source.
Huang, who is usually low-key and rarely speaks out on social media, recently posted a rare message on X in support of an open letter titled 'Open Weights and American AI Leadership'.

The open letter, which has gained over 60 million reads in a short span of time, has seen the number of signatories jump from 25 to over 70, making it clear that the AI industry in Silicon Valley has formed two distinct camps: open-source and closed-source.

The open letter's demands are straightforward: it calls on the industry to support the development of open-source models and opposes regulatory bodies from imposing blanket restrictions on open-source AI models.

Analysts point out that this seemingly technical debate actually touches on several key issues, including preventing startups from being locked into a single model provider, expanding competition from the model layer to the cloud and chip layers, advocating for transparency in technology to improve governance, and defending the use of 'knowledge distillation' (training smaller models using the output of large models) as a legitimate research practice.
The core stance of the open letter can be summed up in one sentence: regulatory bodies should not restrict the development of open-source models to prevent potential risks that have not yet occurred.

Microsoft (MSFT-US) CEO Satya Nadella, Tesla (TSLA-US) CEO Elon Musk, Turing Award winner Yann LeCun, and AI expert Andrew Ng, among others, have signed the open letter, making it one of the largest collective statements in the AI community in recent years.
The signatories' motivations are varied, with each having their own commercial considerations.
Chip and hardware manufacturers like NVIDIA and Dell (DELL-US) are concerned about whether the demand for computing power will continue to grow.

Microsoft, Palantir (PLTR-US), and other cloud service and enterprise software providers hope to enrich their cloud platforms with open-source models, allowing customers to avoid being locked into a single API provider and keeping customers within their cloud and subscription services ecosystem.

The open-source camp, led by Meta (META-US), hopes to control the standards of technology through open models (such as the Llama series); startups like Mistral and Hugging Face also seek to win over customers from closed-source giants.

Venture capital firms like a16z and YC are concerned that if the underlying models are controlled by a few closed-source companies, the profit space for application-layer startups will be significantly compressed, so they support open-source to ensure that startups have room for negotiation on costs and business models.
Anthropic's absence from the open letter has become a focal point, with its employees expressing skepticism about the open-source camp.
Andrew Ng responded that any company has the right to choose not to open-source its code, but it has no right to prevent others from doing so.
The external community believes that Anthropic's cautious attitude towards open-source is closely related to its business model, which relies heavily on the scarcity of model capabilities.

Anthropic's revenue and valuation are largely based on the scarcity of model capabilities. If open-source models appear in the market, the API pricing premium and the capital market's imagination of its growth potential may be affected.
The regulatory policy in the future will also be a variable that the open-source camp must continue to face.

As open-source models continue to approach and even surpass closed-source models in performance, the industry has come to a consensus that large language models are gradually 'infrastructure-izing', becoming low-cost and widely available public resources, and relying solely on parameter scale is no longer a long-term competitive advantage.

In this trend, industry profits may concentrate at both ends: one end is held by chip manufacturers like NVIDIA, and the other end is held by companies that can deeply integrate AI technology with enterprise real data, business processes, and intelligent agents.

At the same time, the importance of data sovereignty and technical security for enterprise customers has increased, making vertical domain models with smaller parameters, private deployment, and performance close to actual needs, as well as edge computing devices (such as AI PCs and AI phones), a more certain commercial direction in the next stage.

This open-source vs closed-source debate may not have a clear conclusion in the short term, but it marks the beginning of the AI industry's transition from a wild-growth early stage to a stage with rules and interest redistribution.

items.title: SpaceX為微軟補AI算力？2027年底拚10GW、年營收衝3000億美元
items.title_en: SpaceX to Supplement Microsoft's AI Computing Power? Aiming for 10GW by 2027 with $300 Billion in Annual Revenue
paras: 太空探索公司 SpaceX(SPCX-US) 正在悄然轉身，從火箭與衛星通訊業務跨足超大規模運算領域，而且擴張速度遠超市場預期，且微軟 (MSFT-US) 有望成為最大客戶。
研究機構 Semianalysis 近期發布報告指出，SpaceX 有機會在 2027 年底前新增超過 10GW 的運算容量，並帶動年度經常性收入（ARR）攀升至 3000 億美元的驚人規模。
這項野心並非空穴來風。馬斯克本人稍早在 SpaceX 首場業績說明會上便已表態，公司設定的「保守」目標是在 2027 年單一年度內完成 6 至 8GW 的新增算力建置與交付，樂觀情況下甚至可能突破 10GW 大關。
若以業界普遍估算的每 GW 約 500 億美元資本支出換算，SpaceX 明年的資本支出恐將落在 3000 億至 5000 億美元之間，這個數字已可與亞馬遜 (AMZN-US) AWS、Google(GOOGL-US) 等雲端龍頭的投資規模相提並論。
分析指出，對一家獲利能力遠不如主流雲端服務商的公司來說，這樣的手筆足以讓市場為之側目。
Semianalysis 表示，該機構已逐站評估 SpaceX 旗下所有適合開發的場址，並持續追蹤其燃氣發電設備的採購進度，認為前述目標具備相當高的執行可行性。
支撐這股擴張浪潮的核心邏輯，在於 AI 推論服務驚人的獲利空間。根據 Semianalysis 自行開發的 Tokenomics 模型與推理模擬器估算，OpenAI 與 Anthropic 在採用輝達 (NVDA-US) GB300 晶片叢集提供 API 推理服務時，每 GW 容量每年可創造超過 1000 億美元營收。
若以每 GPU 每小時 3 美元的保守租賃行情計算，每 GW 的年運營成本僅約 120 億美元，換算下來推理業務毛利率動輒超過 60%，部分主力模型甚至可達 85% 以上。
這套獲利模型同樣適用於微軟。報告指出，微軟已在 2026 年 4 月與 OpenAI 重新談判合作條款，取消了原先 20% 的營收拆分機制，代表微軟未來透過 OpenAI 模型提供推理服務時，能享有與 OpenAI、Anthropic 相近的每 MW 營收與利潤率，卻完全不必負擔模型訓練成本。
Semianalysis 將此形容為「百年一遇的機會」。

微軟自身鬧「算力荒」 SpaceX 趁勢補位

微軟一度在 2024 年底大幅收縮資料中心的租賃步伐，但 Semianalysis 指出，這個局面已在 2025 至 2026 年間出現徹底反轉。
去年 10 月，微軟與 OpenAI 簽下一紙估值高達 2500 億美元的基礎設施即服務協議，Semianalysis 估算此案牽涉約 7GW 算力，也讓微軟自家的 Foundry API 業務與 Copilot 等應用場景一度陷入產能瓶頸。
為填補缺口，微軟今年以來已透過租賃、自建與長期購電協議等多重管道，累計簽下超過 10GW 的算力承諾，總價值超過 3000 億美元。
在此背景下 Semianalysis 認為，微軟與 SpaceX 洽談一筆 3GW、總值約 1500 億美元合約的可能性「並非不可能」，理由有二個：

一是微軟本身正處於算力擴張高峰期，急需新增產能；
二是 SpaceX 比照其對 Anthropic、Google 的合約模式，提供 90 天可解約條款，大幅降低財務風險，也讓內部審批流程更容易過關。


Semianalysis 同時指出，微軟對 SpaceX 算力的潛在需求，將成爲推動 Azure 營收增速從約 42% 躍升至逾 100% 的關鍵變量。

顛覆建廠速度 「速度優先」打法震撼業界

Semianalysis 特別點出，SpaceX 真正的競爭優勢，在於徹底顛覆了傳統資料中心「效率優先」的建設邏輯，改採「速度優先」策略。
報告舉出多個實例：

SpaceX 旗下 Colossus 1 的 300MW 設施僅耗時 122 天便完工；
德州 Southaven 電廠從今年 2 月的 27 台燃氣渦輪機（約 495MW），短短五個月內擴張到 7 月的 69 台、總容量達 1.7GW；
代號「MiniHard」的新專案自 3 月動工後，預計約五個月就能達到 450 至 500MW 規模。


面對供應鏈瓶頸，SpaceX 也採取了多項非典型手段，包括改用中國製電力模組取代積壓逾兩年的大型變壓器、在二手市場搶購燃氣渦輪機（其中部分機組原本預定交付給甲骨文 (ORCL-US) 位於新墨西哥州的據點），並透過高度平行化的施工方式與預組裝壓縮測試週期。
相較同規模資料中心動輒需要更龐大的人力，Colossus 2 高峰期每日用工僅約 3000 人。
Semianalysis 認為，在算力極度稀缺、AI 推理利潤率居高不下的當下，一座能在三個月內交付、又附帶 90 天解約條款的 500MW 叢集，堪稱市場上數一數二稀缺的資產。
而 Google 最終選擇與 SpaceX 簽約，正是這套邏輯最有力的佐證。

資金從何而來？輝達供應商融資成關鍵

針對 SpaceX 是否具備支撐如此龐大資本支出財務實力的外界質疑，Semianalysis 則提出兩條可能路徑。
其一是輝達可能以供應商融資的形式，協助 SpaceX 降低前期現金壓力，被視為馬斯克在業績會上宣布未來將全面採用輝達晶片的重要原因之一，儘管 SpaceX 先前確實評估過 Google TPU 與 AMD 晶片等替代方案。
其二則是 SpaceX 憑藉業界最快的交付速度，以每 MW 每年 3000 萬至 5000 萬美元的溢價定價策略，讓資本支出得以在不到一年內透過營運現金流回收。
綜合上述因素，Semianalysis 推算，即便 SpaceX 2027 年新增的算力中僅有一半投入商業推理變現，其餘留給旗下 Grok 與 Cursor 團隊用於模型訓練，SpaceX 的年度經常性收入仍有望在 2027 年底衝上 3000 億美元大關。
paras_en: SpaceX, a space exploration company, is quietly transforming itself from a rocket and satellite communications business to a large-scale computing domain, with an expansion speed that far exceeds market expectations. Microsoft is expected to become its largest customer.

According to a recent report by research institution Semianalysis, SpaceX has the opportunity to add more than 10GW of computing capacity by the end of 2027, driving its annual recurring revenue (ARR) to a staggering $300 billion.

This ambition is not unfounded. Musk himself has stated that the company's 'conservative' goal is to complete 6-8GW of new algorithmic construction and delivery in 2027, with the possibility of exceeding 10GW.

If calculated based on the industry's common estimate of $5 billion in capital expenditure per GW, SpaceX's capital expenditure next year may fall between $30 billion and $50 billion, a number that can be compared to the investment scale of Amazon's AWS and Google Cloud.
Analysts point out that for a company with far lower profitability than mainstream cloud service providers, this investment is enough to make the market take notice.

Semianalysis states that the institution has evaluated all developable sites under SpaceX and has been tracking the progress of its gas-powered generation equipment procurement, believing that the aforementioned goal has a high degree of feasibility.

The core logic supporting this expansion wave lies in the huge profit space of AI inference services. According to Semianalysis's self-developed Tokenomics model and inference simulator, OpenAI and Anthropic can create over $10 billion in revenue per year per GW of capacity when using NVIDIA's GB300 chip cluster to provide API inference services.

If calculated based on a conservative rental price of $3 per GPU per hour, the annual operating cost per GW is approximately $1.2 billion, resulting in a gross margin of over 60% for the inference business, with some main models reaching over 85%.

This profit model also applies to Microsoft. The report points out that Microsoft renegotiated its cooperation terms with OpenAI in April 2026, canceling the original 20% revenue sharing mechanism, meaning Microsoft will enjoy similar revenue and profit margins to OpenAI and Anthropic when providing inference services through OpenAI models without bearing model training costs.
Semianalysis describes this as a 'once-in-a-century opportunity'.

Microsoft's 'computing power shortage' is being supplemented by SpaceX. Microsoft had significantly reduced its data center leasing pace at the end of 2024 but has since reversed this trend between 2025 and 2026.

In October last year, Microsoft signed a $25 billion infrastructure-as-a-service agreement with OpenAI, which Semianalysis estimates involves approximately 7GW of computing power, causing Microsoft's Foundry API business and Copilot applications to face production bottlenecks.

To fill the gap, Microsoft has signed contracts for over 10GW of computing power commitments this year, with a total value of over $30 billion, through multiple channels such as leasing, self-construction, and long-term power purchase agreements.

In this context, Semianalysis believes that the possibility of Microsoft discussing a 3GW, $15 billion contract with SpaceX is 'not impossible', for two reasons: Microsoft is in a period of rapid expansion and urgently needs new production capacity, and SpaceX offers a 90-day termination clause, significantly reducing financial risk.
Semianalysis also points out that Microsoft's potential demand for SpaceX's computing power will be a key variable driving Azure's revenue growth from approximately 42% to over 100%.
Subverting the traditional construction logic of data centers, SpaceX has adopted a 'speed-first' strategy, which has shaken the industry.

The report cites several examples, including the completion of SpaceX's Colossus 1 facility in just 122 days and the expansion of the Southaven power plant in Texas from 27 gas turbines in February to 69 in July, reaching a total capacity of 1.7GW.

To address supply chain bottlenecks, SpaceX has taken unconventional measures, including using Chinese-made power modules to replace large transformers that have been stockpiled for over two years and purchasing gas turbines on the second-hand market, some of which were originally intended for Oracle's New Mexico facility.
In comparison to similar-scale data centers, which require a much larger workforce, Colossus 2's peak daily labor force is approximately 3,000 people.

Semianalysis believes that in a time of extreme scarcity of computing power and high AI inference profit margins, a 500MW cluster that can be delivered in three months with a 90-day termination clause is a rare asset in the market.
Google's decision to sign a contract with SpaceX is strong evidence of this logic.
Regarding the question of whether SpaceX has the financial strength to support such large capital expenditures, Semianalysis proposes two possible paths.

One is that NVIDIA may provide supplier financing to help SpaceX reduce its upfront cash pressure, which is seen as one of the reasons why Musk announced that SpaceX will fully adopt NVIDIA chips in the future, despite having previously evaluated alternative solutions such as Google TPU and AMD chips.

The other is that SpaceX, with the fastest delivery speed in the industry, can recover its capital expenditures through operating cash flow in less than a year by adopting a pricing strategy with a premium of $30-50 million per MW per year.

Combining these factors, Semianalysis estimates that even if only half of SpaceX's new computing power in 2027 is used for commercial inference, with the rest reserved for model training by its Grok and Cursor teams, SpaceX's annual recurring revenue can still be expected to exceed $30 billion by the end of 2027.

items.title: 台積電7月營收4676億元 年增44%續創單月新高
items.title_en: TSMC July Revenue Reaches NT$467.58 Billion, Up 44.7% YoY
paras: 台積電 (2330-TW)(TSM-US) 今 (10) 日公布 7 月營收，達新台幣 4,675.8 億元，月增 5.6%，年增 44.7%，累計前 7 月營收為新台幣 2 兆 8,720.64 億元，年增 37%；受惠 AI 需求強勁，加上進入蘋果手機備貨期，台積電 7 月營收創下單月新高。
台積電預估，第三季營收 446-458 億美元，以中位數推算，季增 12%，年增 37%，以美元兌新台幣 32 為基礎計算，折合新台幣營收達 1 兆 4,272 億元至 1 兆 4,656 億元，以本月營收推算，8、9 月有機會續創新高。
台積電今日傳出，將與影像感測器龍頭索尼 (Sony) 共砸 1 兆日元，於 2029 年在日本量產次世代影像感測器，負責生產的公司為雙方合資公司，其由索尼出資 60%、台積電出資約 40%，搶佔 AI 視覺、機器人等相關市場。
台積電目前先進製程與先進封裝產能全面滿載，為因應客戶訂單，日前將今年資本支出金額上調至 600 億至 640 億美元，較先前為 520 億至 560 億美元大幅提升，並預計未來數年將維持較高的資本支出金額，被外界看好台積電龍頭地位仍難以撼動，將開啟數年的高速成長趨勢。
paras_en: TSMC (2330-TW)(TSM-US) announced its July revenue today, reaching NT$467.58 billion, up 5.6% MoM and 44.7% YoY.
